newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa ups air cargo rates from March 1.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa ups air cargo rates from March 1.

text.p: Lufthansa Cargo AG said it will raise cargo rates globally by seven to ten percent from March 1.
The general rates rise applies to all Lufthansa Cargo destinations but will vary from one departure country to another according to local market conditions, a company statement said.
Rates from some Latin American and Caribbean countries will go up earlier, from February 15, due to local market needs, it added.
These are Argentina, Mexico, Chile, Uruguay, Colombia, Peru, Venezuela, Ecuador, Guatemala, Costa Rica and the Dominican Republic.
Lufthansa Cargo said it had already increased air cargo prices from Germany to India from January 1.
The increase, first announced by chairman Wilhelm Althen last November, was a reaction to the dramatic and sustained fall in cargo rates in recent years, the airline added.
Althen said: "The rates rises are imperative in face of the continuing downswing of between three and four percent annually in average yields in the entire air cargo industry.

After years of decline: "yields have fallen to a level at which freight companies can no longer operate profitably or make the necessary investments in technical innovation and product quality," he added.

Lufthansa Cargo added that "as the world market leader the rates rises was vital to combat this ruinous price war and to guarantee service quality to partners and clients." --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 8982 Fax +44 171 542 5017
